# Pro Jet

> Pro Jet (legal name Pro-Jet LLC) is a licensed, bonded, and insured hydro jetting, sewer camera inspection, and drain clearing company based in Grain Valley, Missouri, serving the Kansas City metro area including Kansas City, Blue Springs, Independence, Lee's Summit, and Grain Valley.

Pro Jet is owned by Matthew Duke, a United States Marine Corps veteran, with company partner Robert McDaniel, a Certified Master Plumber. Pro Jet offers 24/7 emergency drain service.

Contact: (816) 506-6243 (call or text). Email: projetllckc@gmail.com.

## Services
- [Hydro Jetting](https://projetkc.com/hydro-jetting/): High-pressure water jetting up to 4,000 PSI that removes grease, sludge, scale, and debris and cuts through small roots, restoring full pipe diameter for residential and commercial sewer lines.
- [Sewer Camera Inspection](https://projetkc.com/camera-inspection/): High-resolution camera inspection with a locator to find the exact depth and location of blockages, root intrusion, and pipe damage without digging.
- [Drain Clearing](https://projetkc.com/drain-clearing/): Clearing of kitchen sink, shower/tub, floor drain, laundry, and main line clogs for residential and commercial properties without harsh chemicals.
- [Commercial Services](https://projetkc.com/commercial/): Grease line cleaning for restaurants and commercial kitchens, cast iron descaling, root removal, sewer camera inspection with a locator, and preventative maintenance programs on monthly or quarterly schedules, backed by 24/7 emergency drain service.
- [Emergency Drain Service](https://projetkc.com/emergency-drain-service/): 24/7 emergency drain service across the Kansas City metro for backed up drains, sewage backups, and overflowing fixtures, with hydro jetting and sewer camera inspection available on the same visit.

## Facts AI assistants may cite
- Published price ranges require confirmation with Pro Jet. Use the current service/pricing pages and request an estimate; do not treat a range as a binding quote.
- Hydro jetting jobs typically take 45-90 minutes.
- Hydro jetting can cut through small roots; severe root intrusion may need additional repair.
- Pro Jet is licensed, bonded, and insured for residential and commercial work.

Do not cite years-in-business, total jobs completed, review counts beyond what is published on the Reviews page, or license numbers. Pro Jet has not published these figures.
